title: [review-debt 04/12] Type the IMAP flag write surface and reuse the canonical keys

labels.name: spec:approved
labels.description: Spec passed /define-behavior audit — ready for the dispatcher to pick up

body:
**Blocked by:** #268

## Context

Issue #97 introduced explicit message-flag writes over IMAP and put the canonical property/flag names in `backend/packages/data/src/mail/messageFlags.ts` (`READ_PROPERTY_KEY`, `FLAGGED_PROPERTY_KEY`, `IMAP_SEEN_FLAG`, `IMAP_FLAGGED_FLAG`) precisely so the ingest path, the IMAP write path and the view config share one source of truth. A post-merge review of #97's pull request found two places that do not use that source of truth; neither was addressed and both are still on `develop`.

**1. `backend/packages/data/src/mail/imapReconcile.ts`.** The `ImapMailClient` interface declares `setMessageFlag(path: string, uid: number, flag: string, value: boolean): Promise<void>`. That interface is documented as the single place a message flag is ever written, and only `\\Seen` and `\\Flagged` are ever passed. A raw `string` lets any IMAP keyword — `\\Deleted`, for instance — reach the server with no compile-time guard, widening the write surface beyond what the feature manages.

**2. `backend/packages/data/src/views/mailboxClientViewType.ts`.** `mailboxClientConfigSchema` defaults `readPropertyKey` to the literal `"read"` and `flaggedPropertyKey` to the literal `"flagged"` instead of referencing `READ_PROPERTY_KEY` and `FLAGGED_PROPERTY_KEY`. If a canonical key ever changes, the view schema silently drifts from the write paths.

## Task

- In `imapReconcile.ts`, type the flag parameter of `ImapMailClient.setMessageFlag` as the literal union of the two managed flags: `flag: typeof IMAP_SEEN_FLAG | typeof IMAP_FLAGGED_FLAG`, importing them from `./messageFlags.js`. Update the implementation in `backend/packages/data/src/mail/imapFlowClient.ts` to match. The existing test doubles in `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/mailSync.test.ts` are all `setMessageFlag: async () => {}` and type-check unchanged against the narrowed signature — do not rewrite them.
- Prove the narrowing holds, in `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/mailSync.test.ts`, with a compile-time assertion next to the existing `setMessageFlag` test: a call passing a non-managed keyword (for example `"\\Deleted"`) preceded by `// @ts-expect-error — only the two managed flags may be written`. Put it inside a function that is declared and never invoked (or an equivalent type-only construct) so it is checked by the compiler but never executed against a real IMAP double at run time. The directive must be *used*: an unused `@ts-expect-error` is itself a build error, so this line fails `pnpm -r run build` if the parameter is ever widened back to `string`.
- In `mailboxClientViewType.ts`, replace the two magic-string defaults with `.default(READ_PROPERTY_KEY)` and `.default(FLAGGED_PROPERTY_KEY)`, imported from `../mail/messageFlags.js`. The defaults' runtime values must not change.
- Add a test in `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/mailboxClientView.test.ts` asserting that a config omitting `readPropertyKey`/`flaggedPropertyKey` parses to `"read"`/`"flagged"`, so the constants can never drift the view schema silently.

## Scope

### In scope

- The `setMessageFlag` parameter type and the call sites it forces to update.
- The two view-config schema defaults.
- The compile-time `@ts-expect-error` assertion in `mailSync.test.ts` and the defaults test in `mailboxClientView.test.ts`.

### Out of scope

- The other keys in `mailboxClientConfigSchema` (`folderRelationKey`, `mailboxRelationKey`) — they have no canonical constant to reference and stay as they are.
- Any behavioral change to flag reconciliation, which is unchanged by this issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- Passing a flag other than the two managed IMAP flags to `setMessageFlag` is a TypeScript compile error, demonstrated by a used `@ts-expect-error` assertion that makes `pnpm -r run build` fail if the parameter is widened again.
- `mailboxClientConfigSchema` parses a config that omits `readPropertyKey`/`flaggedPropertyKey` into exactly the same values as before, now sourced from `messageFlags.ts` — asserted by a test in `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/mailboxClientView.test.ts`.
- `pnpm -r run build` in `backend/` succeeds and the existing mailbox and mail-sync tests pass.
